svg.title: Purple White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Purple diamond with adjoining smaller white panel; outline and edge meeting approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of purple, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
